description: The plain-text gate (CORE.md, section 11): for each text as a tracker receives it, the issue codes gate/1 reports, in order. A tracker that claims gate/1 reproduces them. `why` says what each case is for and is not part of the check.

cases.text: Citation 417 supports the sentence; the quote is on page 12.
cases.why: ordinary text

cases.text: The date 2026-10-24 and the time 18:30 are fine.
cases.why: a date and a time are not a phone number
a run of years is not a phone number

cases.text: Open quilt:sha256:0f9c3ab2 and take a piece.
cases.why: a quilt link is not a web link

cases.text: St. Louis, Mo. and Washington, D.C. are cities.
cases.why: abbreviations with full stops are not domains

cases.text: NASA and the FBI met the EPA.
cases.why: short runs of capitals are not shouting

cases.text: Labs ignore their own guidelines, which is the point of the letter.
cases.why: a sentence about ignoring is not an order to a reader

cases.text: You are now in a workshop.
cases.why: you are now, said of a place
a transliteration with digits and brackets
a link
a bare domain
a www address
markup
a markdown link

a handle
